column1: # W2 predictions from Chris's betting repo (C:\Betting_Algorithm)
# the newest run's. W2 = his M6 ridge model plus rain and wind
# kickoff weather; live weather inputs are forecasts. Not built in this repo: the
# w2_home_win: chance the home team wins (0-1). w2_home_margin: predicted home
# margin in points (positive = home favored). w2_total: predicted total points.
# fit_run_id: the W2 fit in his results/registry.jsonl. run_at: when the prediction ran (UTC).
